segments.name: Contract Logistics
segments.description: Provides value-added and dedicated transportation services supporting inbound and internal logistics for industrial manufacturers and major retailers under multi-year contracts.
segments.evidence: We provide value-added and dedicated transportation services to support inbound and internal logistics requirements of industrial manufacturers and major retailers, generally under contractual arrangements of one year or longer.

segments.name: Intermodal
segments.description: Moves international and domestic containers between ports or railheads and customer facilities through company-managed terminals using owner-operators and third-party capacity.
segments.evidence: Intermodal services include steamship-truck, rail-truck, and related support services, primarily moving international and domestic containers between ports or railheads and customer facilities.

segments.name: Trucking
segments.description: Hauls a broad range of commodities for shippers through agents and company-managed terminals using owner-operators, company equipment and brokered capacity.
segments.evidence: Our trucking segment includes dry van, flatbed, heavy-haul, and refrigerated operations, transporting a broad range of commodities including automotive parts, machinery, building materials, food products, steel, and other industrial and consumer goods.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay fees for transporting freight and for customized logistics services, with additional revenue from fuel surcharges and accessorial services.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate substantially all of our revenues from fees charged to customers for transporting freight and providing customized logistics services.

changes.text: In 2024 the former company-managed brokerage reporting segment was closed and its operations discontinued.
changes.evidence: During the third quarter of 2024, the Company recorded aggregate impairment charges totaling $3.7 million within our former company-managed brokerage reporting segment in connection with the closure of those operations.
